tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku tshe'i smad kyi rnam par thar pa mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i skyes bu mchog rab dam pa/ thub pa'i spyan sngar li tsa bī gzhon nu/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du klu sgrub snying po/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'jig rten gsum mgon/ deng sang gi dus na/ chos kyi rje kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes/ snyan pa'i ba dan sa gsum na g.yo zhing*/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i mchog gi sprul sku de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ji lta ba ni shin tu zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir brjod pa'i yul las 'das shing*/ tshu rol so so skye bo'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa yang*/ rgyas par brjod pa shin tu dpag par dka' zhing*/ cha zur tsam brjod pa ni/ dgung lo zhe dgu yan gyi rnam thar rgyas pa/ mkhas grub ras chen pas mdzad pa las shes par bya zhing*/ dgung lo lnga bcu nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i bar gyi rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad pa/ ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan pa'i rnam par thar pa la/ dad pa dang gus pa chen po'i sgo nas cung zad brjod pa ni 'di ltar ro// 'gro ba lha dang mi'i gtsug rgyan dam pa rje rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid dgung lo lnga bcu par phebs pa shing pho spre'u yi lo la u rgyan padma'i sgrub gnas/ grags chen bzhi'i nang nas/ ti sgro gsang ba'i tshogs khang du/ gzhan phan gyi sgrub pa snying po don gyi nyams len la yun ring du bzhugs nas/ phyir phebs lam gyi lung bstan tsha chu sogs te de'i skor gyi chu bo dang*/ chu phran dang*/ mtshe'u mtha' dag yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ hūm̐ dang pheṃ kyi sgra sgrog pa/ gur gum mdog can dwangs shing yid 'phrog pa/ dri bzang gi ngad pa 'thul bas phyogs thams cad khyab pa sogs/

ltas ngo mtshar can bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pas gtso mdzad pa'i sku 'khor thams cad kyi/ mngon sum du mthong grub la byung bas/ rje nyid la ltas ya mtshan can 'di rnams yong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sman gyi mchod pa bla na med pa yin no// zhes gsung zhing*/ gnas bstod ngo mtshar can yang mdzad do// yang dus skabs shig la chab tshan la phebs rjes/ sku grib la brten pa gnyan 'brum gyi rnam pa zhig sku la byung ba la brten pa'i/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam shin tu snyel tshul bstan pa'i mthar/ gzims chung na thugs dam gtor ma mdzad grub rjes/ sku ngal ba zhig gi skabs na/ sku zur g.yas phyogs kyi ka gdong gsol cog bsgrigs pa'i steng na/ yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku yongs su rdzogs pa byis pa lo bdun pa'i tshad tsam yod pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' 'ja' ris su bzhes pa zhig 'dug pa gzigs ma thag nyams kyi snang ba yin dgongs nas/ chags zhen 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba nyid kyi sku dang dbyer med pa snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pa'i ngang nas/ yang sku g.yon gyi ka gdong na/ bu mo shin tu mdzes shing lang tsho dar la bab pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yi dam dngos kyi cha lugs su bzhugs pa'i gsung gis/ mos gus gsol btab mdzad nas kyang*// dbang bzhi bzhes par mi spro'am// zhes gsung byung dus sku shed kyi ma lcogs bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ phyag gi nem nem mdzad pas/ snang la sdos bcas kyi rang bzhin du ma grub par 'ja' lus su 'dug pas/ mos gus dang dag snang khyad par can 'khrungs te/ dbang bzhi ka yongs su rdzogs par blangs nas/ de ka'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ snyung gzhi ni de ka'i mod la rang sangs la song 'dug lus sems la sngon chad med pa'i bskyed rim gyi gsal nyams/

'dzin med kyi stong nyams/ zag med kyi bde nyams/ gnyis med zung 'jug gi rtogs pa sngar las khyad par du gyur pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ rdo rje theg pa'i zab don dbang bzhi'i don mthar thug pa/ dus 'di nas mngon du gyur pa yin no// de ltar lung ston pa'i bu mo de ni rdo rje phag mo dngos su yin par thugs yid ches nas/ zhal gnyis ma'i chog sgrigs de yang rje btsun mas bskul nas/ dar rgyas su mdzad pa'o// 'di lta bu'i tshul 'di ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje phag mos zhal dngos su bstan pa la/ rje rin po che nyid kyi smin byed dbang bzhi zhus nas/ grol byed lam bzhi'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i mdzad pa mthar thug pa mchog tu gyur pa yin no// de dag gi don ni/ rje nyid kyi thugs dam nyams len rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i nang du/ rlung sems khams dkar dmar dang bcas pa dbyer med du 'dres pas zag med kyi bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa thugs la 'khrungs pa'i nus pa/ ye shes dag pa'i 'char sgo la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi zhal dngos su bstan pa la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus nas/ sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa yin no// de dag gi don tshigs su bcad de smras pa ni 'di ltar ro// 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon kun dga'i mtshan can de'i// zab don dbang bzhi'i don la legs sbyangs pas// mdud bral dbu ma chos kyi pho brang der// rlung sems thig le dbyer med 'dres pa'i mthus// ye shes 'gag med bde chen rol pa'i gar// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la// dngos su dbang nos lam bzhi'i rtogs pa skyed// sku bzhi tshe gcig 'grub pa khyod nyid tsam// snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi sprul sku kun dga' rin chen gyi// zhabs pad bsten cing mos pas gsol 'debs rnams// yongs 'dzin 'di 'dras rjes bzung blo re bde// gdung shugs drag pos snying nas gsol ba thob// byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med// ces pa'o// ti sgror sku mtshams grol nas/

dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa 'dren gyi bar la/ zhing khams gzhan gyi gdul bya la dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung bgros nges pa can phebs tshul ni/ phyogs kyi dad 'dus mnga' ris dang*/ dbus gtsang dang*/ dwags kong dang*/ mdo khams la sogs pa nas/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rnal 'byor pho mo la sogs pa dad 'dus kyi gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshogs pa rnams la/ gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas drang nges kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa dbyar chos dang dgun chos la sogs pa zab cing rgya che ba gsungs so// de'i tshe chos ra nam tshogs dus su/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i dmigs sogs nan gyi rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par snying po'i nyams len bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa la/ rang res kyang lag rjes che ba zhig rang dgos rgyu yin te/ yid bzhin nor bu dgra mang ba ltar cung zad dka' tsam byung*/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas par dka'/ dgos zab chos nyams su len pa nyung*/ khyad par dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa 'di lta bu yang 'chad mkhan dkon/ rang re lta bu yang rgyun ring sdod pa'i chos can min pas/ rgya bshad stong bshad byas kyang don tsa nyams len la 'bung dgos pa yin no zhes/ zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gsung dang*/ thugs skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi mdangs yod pa'i bka' lung*/ bu slob rnams nyams len la bskul ba'i zhal bkod yang yang gnang gin 'dug dus/ chos nyan gyi grwa bu slob dbang rnon kha re nang phan tshun/ rje rin po che'i gsung 'byon lugs 'di/ zhing gzhan du myur bar 'byon pa'i gsung rigs 'dra yang*/ don la dpe med las che snyam pa'i ngang la nang phan tshun cung zad gleng ba dang*/ bla ma dang bral dogs pa'i gdung ba drag po dang*/ sems khong du chud pa'i skyo shas kyi ngang nas/

mig mchi mas gang zhing*/ ngag tu shugs ring 'byin par byed do// chos nyan phal cher ni/ rje rin po che zhing gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung nges pa can ni ma go// las 'bras la yid ches dgos tshul dang*/ tshe la long med pas zab don nyams len la 'bung dgos tshul gyi gsung bgros khyad par can rnams rang rgyud la 'byor bas/ der 'dus pa thams cad 'khor ba la yid skyo zhing nges par 'byung ba'i ngang nas/ don gyi nyams len la brtson zhing*/ thugs dam la bogs thon pa yin no// de ltar zhing khams gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung bgros shugs 'byung la/ chos ra bzhugs gral sogs gang phebs su gsungs kyang*/ rjes la go ba ma gtogs de dus zhing gzhan du 'byon par ma go ba sha stag yin no// yang skabs shig tu/ dus 'khrug tsho la brten pa'i thugs nges par 'byung zhing*/ zhing gzhan du 'byon pa'i gsung bgros chos ra sogs su shugs 'byung la 'di ltar gsungs so/ spyir 'khor ba skyid med sdug bsngal rang bzhin la// bye brag snyigs ma'i dus kyi skye dgu rnams// bsod nams phyogs re gang la'ang yid brtan med// bde skyid snang ba byis pa'i rtse dga' 'dra// mi rtag 'gyur ba tsho soms la lha chos gyis// bla ma yang yang du rnyed dka' gdams ngag long*// dam chos zab mo dang phrad dka' 'bungs la bsgom// dus ngan skye bo rnams gdul dka' 'thab rtsod can// ban rgan skyu ra yang mi sdod 'gro snying 'dod// da ltar gsol ba re btab na phyi ma yang 'phrad// snyigs ma'i sems can tsho snying re rje na yang*// thub chen klu sgrub skyob pas grongs tshul bstan// ban rgan phung po nam 'dor cha med do// zhes pa la sogs pa'i thugs skyo shas kyi sgo nas gsung gzhug thung thung 'ba' zhig gsungs so// rje 'gro ba'i mgon po skyob pa kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa thugs stobs shin tu che zhing*/

thugs bzhed ji ltar yod pa bzhin/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rtsol med du grogs mdzad cing*/ dngos su bka' lung dang du len pa'i zhabs 'bring ba/ skye ba dpag tu med pa nas/ rje 'di nyid kyi phrin las sgrub par smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyar ba'i skyes mchog ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i tshad med pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa/ ma rungs pa tshar gcod pa'i dpa' bo chen po dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan nyid kyi/ rje nyid kyi dgongs bzhed rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa/ dpon blon gyi tshul bzung nas dngos su bsgrubs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab la/ khyad par thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang sngar yod pa rnams las rgya che zhing spangs mtho ba/ lha grangs mang ba/ bzo'i khyad par ya mtshan zhing*/ gzungs gzhug ngo mtshar ba dang bcas pa legs par grub pa la/ rje btsun rang nyid kyi rab tu gnas pa gnang dus me tog gi char 'bab pa dang*/ bar snang nas rol mo'i sgra 'byung ba dang*/ sa gzhi dri bzang gi ngad pa 'thul ba sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can dang bcas te yongs rdzogs su grub pa ni/ sbrul lo nas dbu btsugs nas/ bya lo ston zla ra ba'i skabs der grub pa yin no// de yang mi dbang chen po mgon po rgyal mtshan pas tshad med pa'i khur bzhes te/ sprul pa'i bzo'i dpon mo che 'khor bcas la/ gnang sbyin 'bul ba gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ ja sig gos dar rkang 'gro la sogs pa/ rnam thos sras kyi dpal la 'gran pa lta bus tshim par byas pa'i/ yon rdzongs dang dga' ston rgya chen pos rab gnas su/ gser gdugs kyi bka' bkod kyang dang du blangs te/ rje nyid la mi brjed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i ngang nas byon pa yin no// rgyas par ni mkhas grub ras chen pas gong du bstan pa ltar dang*/ sgo mang rang gi dkar chag las shes par bya ba yin no// dus skabs der/

sde pa 'ol kha ba btson du bzung yod pa yang*/ thugs byams pa chen po'i sgo nas chos 'jig rten gyi bka' drin bzang po dang bcas/ rang gnas su bskyal ba sogs gnod lan du phan btags pa'i mchog gi mdzad pa kho na la spyod pa yin no// yang dus der rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa la yang bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya sogs rten 'brel gnang sbyin dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa/ dgos bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' lung gnang ba la sogs te/ dus rtag tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i ched du/ rnam dkar gyi bya ba rlabs po che 'ba' zhig la 'jug par mdzad pa'o// bdag sogs 'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs gnas dam pa/ skyob pa kun dga'i mtshan can/ 'di nyid kyi bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i zhal gzigs nas/ de nyid la chos dngos su gsan pa dang*/ chos skyong gi phrin las rtsol med du sgrub pa dang*/ sde brgyad dang 'byung po sogs bran du 'khol ba dang*/ sngon mkhyen dang grub rtags dpag tu med pa ston nus pa sogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ phal cher ni shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyi sbed pa kho na rang du mdzad pa yin no// sku tshe'i stod la so so skye bo'i mig lam du mngon sum du cung zad rig pa rnams ni/ rnam thar chen mo las shes par bya zhing*/ sku tshe smad la mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ mthu stobs dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pas bdud dang log 'dren tshar gcad cing zil gyis mnan pa'i tshul ni/ las dag pa'i sku 'khor rnams kyi cha zur tsam rig pa mdor bsdus brjod na/ bla ma dam pa 'bri gung ras chen pa de nyid/ dus nam zhig gi tshe 'brum bu snyung ste/ rdo ra dkar mor sbra phub nas dpon slob 'ga' bzhugs dus/ snyung zug shin tu che zhing*/

'dug pa'i sa gzhi thams cad chus gang ba/ nam mkha' mes khyab pa/ bar snang mun nag 'khrigs pa'i dkyil du/ gshin rje'i gzugs sna tshogs pas mtshon cha thogs nas/ ya nga ba'i ltas sna tshogs pas sdigs shing*/ de dang dus mnyam par/ dpon slob kun kyi shangs lam du/ gseb dri rgyal lhog lhog pa byung tshe/ dbu mang po brtsegs pa'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs gcig mthong byung ma thag dang por dgongs pa la/ 'jigs byed red snyam pa'i snang ba byung ba la gzugs brnyan de ni/ dbu dgu po sba ba dgu byas pa'i mdog sngo skya thal ba'i mdog can zhig gis/ dgrad mig dang*/ mi gdug pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po bstan byung ba la/ thugs dran med du 'gro tshad pa la/ a tsa ma sems can thams cad la/ 'di lta bu'i bdud kyi sdug bsngal zhing 'jigs pa skyed par byed pa 'di/ snying re rje snyam pa'i snying rje tshad med pa thugs la 'khrungs te/ sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar byed pa la/ rje la gsol ba 'debs pa las thabs gzhan med snyam nas/ rje nyid la mos gus tshad bzung med pa zhig skyes nas/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ skad cig de nyid la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje de nyid khri bkod pa mchog dang ldan pa'i steng du sku la snam sbyar dmar ser nyis rtsegs dang*/ dbu la sgom zhwa bzhes pa'i gsung gis/ bu bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab na nad las myur du grol bar 'gyur ro// rang gi lan chags 'khor ba'i phyir du 'byung po la rang lus la bton pa'i khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin zhig 'jigs rgyu med do gsungs te/ sku nam mkhar yal te mi snang bar gyur to// dus der thugs sos pa'i dran pa rnyed de nyams bzang po shar/ rang lus gtar ba'i khrag gi gtor ma bsngos pas/ bgegs de rlung dmar zhig tu gyur nas/ gzhu rong mda' thon nas song ngo*// der ras chen pa'i thugs la/ nga'i bla ma dam pa 'di skyob pa dngos red snyam nas/ mos gus lhag par skyes te/

bka' drin 'khor du med pa'i gsol 'debs de yang dus der mdzad cing*/ rje nyid kyi lung bstan pa ltar nad las myur du grol ba yin no// yang ye shes mgon pos 'bral med du phrin las sgrub pa'i rtags ni/ sku zur g.yas g.yon du bya rog shin tu snum pa gnyis yang yang du gzigs pa dang*/ yang sku mtshams mdzad kha dang phyed thun gyi dus/ sku zur g.yas g.yon gyi stegs la/ khyi nag dang kha dkar ba/ spyi bo 'bur ba zhig rgyun du yong ba/ sde pa dgon po rgyal mtshan pas dngos su gzigs pa sogs shin tu mang ngo*// yang sgo mang bzhengs khar/ dpon mo che pa rnams dus thog la ma sleb pa la/ mi drags pa dos chod gtong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas ngas ye shes mgon po la gsol ba btab 'od gsal gyi gsal snang la mi gos dkar po gyon pa/ lus kyi phyag tshad snyoms zhing*/ yan lag rags la che ba/ skra se 'bal le ba/ rgyan dang bcas pa/ lag na lcang rgyug bzung ba gcig na re/ bdag cag khyed kyi phrin las sgrub mkhan gyi bzo bo lags te/ zhag bdun la sleb par byed zer ba byung bas/ mi gtong mi dgos gsungs nas/ mi ma btang bas/ zhag bdun thog rang du sleb byung bas/ dbyibs dang cha lugs de rnams dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa rang du 'dug pa dang*/ lcang rgyug lam ngor 'dug cing*/ dpon mo che rnams chos skyong gi bkug pa/ thugs dam 'od gsal gyi gzigs lam du phebs pa yin no// gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs mdzad dus kun yang*/ bzo rigs pa chos skyong gi bskul ba'i lo rgyus brjod kyi mi lang ba yod cing*/ khyad par sgo mang bzhengs dus/ byar pa dpon mo che pa rnams la chos skyong gi bskul ma byung tshul/ dkar chag na zur tsam yod do// yang sgo mang bzhengs pa'i skabs shig la/ 'byung po bdud rigs rnams kyis ma bzod par/ ngan sems phrag dog gi mtho brtsams te/

dpon mo che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ sprul sku ngag dbang grags pa/ phra pa dpon mo che rnams/ rim pas blo bur gyi nad drag pos btab nas/ rim gro sman dpyad gang gis kyang ma lhongs par tshe'i dus byed par nye ba'i skabs su/ rje btsun nyid kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen po'i ngang nas/ 'byung po la gtor ma gnang*/ byams snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i mod la/ khong rnams nad drag po las myur du grol nas/ phyag 'bul la 'phral du sleb nas/ bzo la 'jug thub pa byung bas/ dpon mo che rnams/ rje nyid la mi brjed pa'i dad pa thob ste/ rje btsun nyid kyi/ bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis non cing chos skyong gis phrin las rtsol med du sgrub par yid ches te bcos min gyi dad pa thob pa yin no// yang gsol ja ba gzungs dar 'chi ru nye ba'i nad kyi btab dus/ rje nyid kyi 'byung po la gtor ma zhig gnang nas/ bden stobs dang*/ mgon po'i bka' bsgo bas 'phral du bde ba kun kyi mthun grub du byung ba sogs nad pa drag po la/ byin rlabs bden stobs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad las grol ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ brjod kyis mi lang ba yin no// gzhan yang sgrub sde'i chos khrims rin chen bshes gnyen bya ba/ mgo nad kyi rims drag pos btab ste/ 'chi bar thag chod nas/ 'chi khar/ rje btsun bla ma nyid dang ma mjal ba yid shin tu skyo shing*/ zug gzer gyi bzod glags med par gyur pa'i tshe/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga'i mtshan can thugs rje'i bdag nyid can de mdun gyi nam mkha' la dngos su phebs te/ 'chi kha dang bar do'i gdams ngag 'di gsungs so// bu rin chen bshes gnyen dad gus can// khyod da lta nad kyis gdungs pa 'dis// tshe sngon gyi las sgrib 'dag par nges// da tshe 'di'i re ltos kun bor la// grogs skyel ma 'chi kha'i gdams ngag dang*// gnyen bsun ma bar do'i nyams len gnyis// pha bla mas da lta ston pa 'di// don nyams su longs la spro ba skyed// lus 'byung bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig dus 'dir// sgom 'od gsal 'char bas ma bu 'phrod// gshis 'dzin med phyag rgya chen por zhog

/de ma shes 'gro la snying rje soms// gnad 'di kas zung 'jug lam sna zin// 'di bar do dag pa'i gdams ngag ces// mgon rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du// yab skyu ra 'jig rten mgon pos gsungs// las ngan pa'i dbang gis gal te yang*// lus bar do'i snang ba 'char srid pas// sems skrag dngangs ma byed 'di ltar soms// skyon rnam smin phung po bor bas legs// skyabs bla ma yi dam bzhugs gnas su// grogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma 'ong*// 'od snang cha steng gi sbubs thag la// sems dran pas 'jus la lhug par zhog /pha bla ma'i gdams ngag 'chug mi srid// ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' 'di shin tu gnyan// bu da ltar ltung ba bshags bsdam gyis// dbang bzhi rdzogs longs la lta ba skyongs// de legs par go 'am snying re rje// khyod ma 'jigs ma 'jigs bla mas skyob// skyabs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyings dang*// bu lus ngag yid gsum ro gcig zhog /ces gsung ba'i dus/ de dag gi rgyu mtshan rnams nad g.yog pa rnams la bshad de/ kho rang thal mo snying khar sbyar/ bla ma'i snang ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas dbugs song ste/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag las grol nas lam sna zin pa yin no// gzhan yang nad pa rje la dad pa che ba dag 'chi khar 'bri gung rin po che'i drung du byang zhus thub pa gyis zer ba'i kha chems bzhag pa la shi dus/ rje btsun nyid kyi byang zhus gnang ba'i tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung ba dang*/ yang byang zhus thub pas mi lus thob ste/ gzhon nu gtam smra shes tsam nyid nas rang gi skye ba dran te/ nged mi lus thob pa/ 'bri gung kun dga' rin chen la byang zhus thob pa'i bka' drin yin/ zhes pa bgrang gis mi lang byung ba da lta yang yod pa mngon sum du mthong zhing grub pa yin no// yang byang pa gcig gi byang shog bsregs pas/ shog bu la me rtsa ba nas ma 'bar bar/ byang zhus kyi phyag phyi ba rnams ci byed la thug pa la kho'i rnam shes gdon gdug pa can gyis 'dir ma btang bar 'dug dgongs nas thugs zag med kyi ting 'dzin ye shes kyi ngar dang ldan pas gshin po'i rnam shes gdon dang phral te gnas spar ba dang*/

gdon la snying rje drag po 'khrungs pa'i ngang nas phaṭ ces gsungs ma thag me 'bar zhing*/ phyag g.yog pa rnams kyang*/ shin tu skrag pa'i zil chen po dang bcas pa'i rjes la/ rig pa 'dzin med du cham me song 'dug rje btsun nyid ni da dung yang spyan lta stangs ha re ba'i ngang la bzhugs 'dug go// phyis gshin po'i rnam shes gshed ma dang phral zhing*/ gnas spar ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa yin no// gzhan yang*/ 'ga' zhig 'chi ba'i dus byas te gnas pa la sdad pa la/ rje nyid kyi byang bu'i sgrol chog gnang ma thag gnas pa las grol ba ni/ da lta mngon sum du mthong ba shin tu mang ba mngon sum du rig pa yin no// de lta bu la sogs pa/ mthong thos dran reg byang chub kyi lam la bkod pa'i mdzad pa rlabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ brjod kyis mi lang ba yod na'ang*/ brda zur tsam las/ shin tu gsang ba rnams bri bar ma spobs pa yin no// de nas khyi lo dpyid khar sleb dus/ thog ma med pa'i las ngan drag pos bskul te/ sngon rgya bod gang du yang ma srid pa'i 'byung po'i lhongs tshad/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chags sgo/ dge 'dun kha shugs che ba ma rungs pa 'ga' zhig gi thugs rgyud gdon gyi btab pa la brten pa'i bslab gsum kyi ngur smrig 'dzin pa khri phrag mang po dbang med du bskul nas/ dmag chen gyi g.yul bshams nas rang gi khri zhabs dkyil du sleb byung dus dge 'dun gyi sde 'khrug la thugs kyi ma longs bzhin/ pha rol kyi g.yul zlog pa la/ dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan sgar thog tu phebs dgos pa byung dus yang*/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ shi bsad med pa dang*/ mig dang*/ sgyid pa mi gcod pa dang*/ dmag 'khrug yun thung ba sogs kyi bka' bkod kho na mdzad cing*/ mi shi ba byung na yang*/ bsngo ba rgyas par gnang ba dang*/ thugs byams pa chen po'i ting 'dzin gyi ngang nas/ spyir dus kyi dmag 'khrug zhi ba dang*/

dgos dge 'dun gyi sde 'khrug thams cad zhi zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bshad sgrub thams cad rgyas pa'i smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa yin no// de ltar ngo bo stong nyid snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rnam pa bdud dang log 'dren ma rungs pa thams cad lta stangs dang nus pas zil gyis non pa ni/ shing dbang gi drung du thub pa'i dbang po bdud dpung gi tshogs las rgyal ba'i mdzad pa lta bu yin no// de nas khyi lo'i nang gi sgrub sde'i spyi bsod rnams mgyogs par bsdu ba mdzad de/ sgrub mchod snga myur la grub par mdzad/ dgun gyi ras chos pa stong phrag tsam la dbon rin po ches gtso bo gnang ba'i bka' khyab snga 'gros la grub pa'i sku mtshams bcad rgya ma ltos che ba yang grub par gyur par yin no// de rjes ka tshal chos 'khor bka' bkod bzhin grub pa la thugs bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs bden tshig gnang ba'o// dus de tsam na zhing 'dir cung zad thugs bag phebs pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa ni/ thub pas kyang*/ myang 'das kyi mdo gsungs nas/ sku tshe zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i rten 'brel ltar yin par mngon no// de nas sgrub sde'i lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi rje mtshams/ phag lo'i sos ka mtshams bzhugs pa rnams la/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis su khrid gnang ba'i dgong re bzhin bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung bgros tshig 'di 'dra re re la 'ang*/ dgos pa gal che ba zab pa'i gnad ngo mtshar can re yod pas/ da lta nged kyi bshad pa tsho la ye le bar byed par 'dug na'ang*/ chos nyan bshad dang chos ra gcig tu yang yang 'dzom pa yang dka' bas/ nyams len la 'bungs dang*/ dus tshod gcig na/ khyed rnams la yang dge sbyor da lta las khyad par du gyur pa re skye zhing*/ kho bo la yang cung zad mos su 'gro ba'i skabs shig yong ba yin/

phugs zhing khams gcig tu 'du ba'i rten 'brel che ba yin pas/ dpon slob phyogs mthun du ting nge 'dzin thun re bsgom gsungs nas/ khrid ma grol bar dgongs re bzhin dpon slob phyogs mthun du mnyam bzhag mdzad pa dang*/ yang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa 'di bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas khyed mtshams pa rnams kyis kyang dge sbyor la 'bungs/ gsum thob dbyar mjal sogs gling gyen thur ches pas ma thub dogs pas/ dge sbyor yod pa rnams la/ dri ba dang dogs gcod re tsam dgos pa yod na da lta gyis/ las dang po pa rnams la khrid ma btab par/ ngo sprod pa 'tshang re che na'ang*/ gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlob pa'i sa yin pas/ rnam rtog gi bye brag bar chad kyi rkyen la dran pa rgyag lugs sogs 'di 'dra dgos gsung ba'i bka' lung dgong re bzhin gnang ba dang*/ yang mtshams la bzhugs pa'i bla ma sogs drags rims rnams la gsung bgros zab la rgya che ba nges pa can du gsungs pa ni/ bstan pa spyi la thun mong du grags pa gzhan bzhed bya ba la'ang 'di dang 'di 'dra'i rigs yin/ mdo rgyud zab mo na bzhugs kyang bod snga ma tshos zur ma thon pa/ skyob pa'i thugs dgongs zab mo la shar ba'i rang bzhed ni/ 'di lta bu sogs yin gsung ba zhib rgyas mang po phebs kyang*/ mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa'i bka' chems yin pa'i go ba/ de dus ni phal cher la ma chags phyis su ni chos nyan kun nges shes 'drongs nas/ phar tshur gleng slong da lta'i bar du yang byed par gyur to// de ltar bdag sogs 'gro ba lha dang mi'i skyabs mgon dam pa chos kyi rje kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las/ sku gsung thugs kyi mthu stobs dang*/ rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas/ zhing 'dir gdul bya dang mdzad pa phrin las rdzogs par bstan pa'i le'u yin no// ༈ //rje dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje dang phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo skyob pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid/

zhing 'dir gdul bya dang smon lam mdzad pa phrin las rnams rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ zhing gzhan gyi 'gro don che bar dgongs nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ gong du bstan pa ltar chos ra nam 'tshogs dang*/ bzhugs yul gar phebs su thugs skyo shas kyi sgo nas/ rang re rnams kyang yun ring 'grogs pa dka' zhes pa dang*/ ban rgan skyu ra yang mi sdod 'gro snying 'dod// ces sogs mang du gsungs shing bya lo tshun nas/ da lta phan/ bzhugs yul gang phebs/ 'ja' 'od 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par gzims khang gi steng na 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan zug pa dang*/ mtshan mo gzims chung gi rab gsal la 'ja' 'od rgyun ldan du zug pa dang*/ me tog gi char zim bu rgyun du 'bab pa dang*/ gzugs mi mngon pa'i skor ba byed pa'i sgra rgyun du 'byung ba dang*/ yang ri dwags mang pos skor ba byed pa dngos su mi 'ga' res mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhing gzhan du 'gro ba'i don la spyan 'dren pa'i ltas khyad par can yin no// yang khyi lo'i nang du/ bla ma nyag re rtogs ldan zer ba'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig gzhu rong bar tshigs kyi ri khrod na bzhugs pa'i sar/ bud med nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan pa sngo zhing mdzes pa rgyan du mas mdzes pa zhig byung ba la/ gang nas 'ongs sogs zhib du dris pas/ des bdag spun bdun phrag gsum da nang rdo rje gdan nas yongs/ rdo rje gdan bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pa la/ phyi pas nang pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' bar byas/ du ru ka sogs kyis bstan pa la chags 'jig gi skabs su yod pas/ 'di bas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'gro phan rdo rje gdan che bas/ 'bri gung rin po che gdan 'dren du btang ba yin te/ phebs ma gsan na bdag tsho ngo gnong ste/ do nub rdo rje gdan du slebs pa zhig 'gro zer ba byung*/ yang zla ba sting ma'i tshes bcu gsum zhig la/

bud med dmar mo ras kyi ang rag gyon zhing rgyan du ma yod pa/ mkhar gsil thogs pa bud med kha dog mi gcig pa lnga tshan dang*/ paṇa zhu dang sgom thag thogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i cha lugs can gnyis dang bcas pa byung*/ snga ma bzhin dris pas/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di gal che zhing*/ bstan pa yang mgo tshugs par 'dug na'ang*/ rdo rje gdan gal che bar byung bas/ 'bri gung rin po che gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa/ de nas rtsis pa'i zla ba hril po bcu la phebs par yod/ khyod kyang nged tsho dang sbrags nas 'gro dgos rgyu yin zer ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang*/ rtogs ldan des khong rang gi grwa pa dang*/ yon bdag rnams bsdus nas/ dngos po gang yod tshogs 'khor byas/ kha skad lung bstan byung tshul rnams bshad 'dug pas/ bla mas lha mthong 'dre mthong bshad na mi dga' zer ba byung 'dug na'ang*/ don la mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan rang yin par nges te/ de nas dus mi ring bar bla ma nyag re yang mya ngan las 'das shing*/ rje nyid kyang zhing gzhan du mkha' 'gro'i gdan 'dren la zhal gyis bzhes pa'i lung bstan nges pa can yin no// yang khyi lo'i sde 'khrugs kyi skabs shig tu/ bla ma 'phags pa zer ba'i rtogs ldan bzang po/ 'phral shig nad kyis btab pa zhig yod pa de na re/ rje btsun rin po che/ khyed kyi sku tshe'i ring la dmag 'khrug mang po yong ba 'di rgyu ci lags zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ rtogs ldan 'phags pa khyod la/ tshe'i ring la shig nad rang yong ba ci yin gsungs pas/ sngon las yin pa 'dra zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ sngon las kyang yin las che ste/ nged kyi ring la dmag byed dgos yong ba ni/ shes bya'i sgrib pa phra mo zhig gi rkyen pa yin 'dug khyed la shig mang po yong ba ni/ las kyi sgrib pa red/ nged rang gnyis ka'i rkyen 'di/ thod pa ma bzhag bar la 'chad bsam pa mi 'dug gsung ngo*// rje rin po che/ nged rang dpon slob gnyis kyi dbu thod ci tsam thub pa lags zhus pas/

rje'i zhal nas dbu thod gnyis po 'dis/ lo 'khor bsam pa mi snang*/ a cang su la yang ma 'chad cig khyod rtogs ldan yin pas grub rtags shig ston dang gsungs pas/ rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pas/ bla ma 'phags pa thugs nyams 'ur nas khru gang tsam 'phags pas/ rje'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi de la grub rtags zer ba min/ nyams snang rlung gi yon tan yin/ de 'dras cang yong ba min gsungs nas/ rje nyid bzhugs gdan las 'phags nas/ nam mkha' la ling nge phebs nas bar snang la dar gcig bzhugs dus gzims khang gi sgo khrog zer nas byung ba dang*/ bzhugs gdan la phebs nas/ 'khrul 'khor zer tsa na de 'dra yong ba yin/ zhes gsungs so// de'i phyi lo bla ma 'phags pa sku gshegs khar spyan chab bsil bas/ snyung g.yog pas khyed rtogs ldan yin pas/ ma bshum zhig bya bral sna mang pas skur pa zhu yong ngo zhus pas/ nga ni zhag gsum bzhi na 'chi ste 'tsher ba min/ nga la rje rin po che'i bka' lung 'di bzhin gnang yod pa/ rje nyid kyang gzhan don la phebs pa 'dug snyam pa yin gsungs pa ni/ de dus kyi 'khor rnams kyis nges pa'o// de dag ni rje rin po che rang gi gsung rjen pa la zhing gzhan du 'byon par gsungs pa yin no// yang sngon 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po de nyid kyis/ lcag tshan gyi tsha ru gcig gling gi dkyil gyi brag la btsugs nas/ shing 'dis st+wa yu dang ste'u yu nyan dus/ skor gcig sleb yong gsungs pa dang*/ gser khang sgo bcad mar/ khri thog bcu gsum dus/ 'byon par lung bstan pa ltar/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon de nyid rang gi gdul bya'i lhag ma skyong ba la byon pa ni/ rje kun dga' rin chen 'di nyid yin te/ khri thog bcu gsum pa yin pa dang*/ lung bstan pa'i shing de yang*/ st+wa yu dang*/ ste'u yu nyan par sleb cing*/ sku mya ngan la 'da' khar shing de yang rtsa ba nas gog nas byung ba ni/ rje nyid zhing gzhan du 'byon pa'i ltas thun mong ma yin pa'o// de nas phag lo'i lo gsar du sleb pa'i skabs su/

rje rin po che 'di nyid sngar gyi lugs ltar/ thugs dam nyams len gyi rim pa thugs lhag par gzhol ba'i ngang nas/ phyogs kyi dad 'dus rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhugs so// de'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi sku la snyun mi mnga' yang*/ gsol ja bzhes pa sogs kyang*/ sngar bzhin mi bzhes pa dang*/ gsung 'byon kyang gzhug thung thung gnang ba sogs/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i yid mi ches pa re/ sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan pas gtsos pa'i phyag g.yog pa rnams la byung yang*/ thugs cung zad rmongs pa'i ngang nas rgyu mtshan gyi dogs gcod zhu ba ma byung ba yin gsungs so// de nas phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du chab tshan la phebs pa'i thog tu chab grib kyi rnam pas/ sku khams cung zad nyog pa tsam byung*/ sdengs rgyal nas rdor 'dzin kun dga' legs pa phyag 'bul la byon/ zhag gcig gnyis song nas/ ri khrod la 'gro bar zhus pas/ nged kyi tshwa chu'i ring la khyed kyang sdod/ sa cha 'di dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams dag cing*/ nged rang rnams kyang*/ dri bshad kho thag chod pa zhig byed/ mtshams pa rnams kyang 'dir bos dang*/ nga yang dga'/ khong tsho rnams la'ang phan pa yin gsung ba dang*/ chab gzims la phebs so// der dbon rin po che dang*/ rtogs ldan yang kha shas dang*/ sku rim pa rnams dang bcas pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i sar/ gsung rab kyi go don rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa dang bstun pa'i dge sbyor kyi sgrigs rim/ zab la rgya che ba mang po zhig gsungs pa'i mtshams su/ ma ṇi'i bro brdung gi tshul du/ gar nyams gnang bzhin 'di gsungs so// rnam rtog gi ri rgyal brtan par sdod// nyi zla skar gsum gling bzhi yongs la 'gro// 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi drung du 'dzom pa'i smon lam yod// ces pa la sogs/ bro brdung rgyun ring bar gnang bas/ sku 'khor rnams kyang*/ the tshom gyi gzhi che bar byung yang*/ 'di byed kyi gtol ma rnyed pa'i ngang nas/

'phral du mtshe'u khar spyan drangs te/ sku rim ltos che ba btsugs rung*/ bka' lung bzang ngan gang yang mi gsungs kyang*/ sku khams dwangs pa zhig e yong bsam pa'i sku rin la dmigs pa'i 'gyed kyi bye brag nyin re bzhin byas kyang*/ dam sel can gyi 'grul pa snga rting gis rkyen ngan pa la brten nas/ khad kyis sku shed chung bar mngon pa byung bas/ sku khams 'tsho mi 'tsho the tshom skyes te/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pas tshes bzhi'i nang zhogs snga bar/ rje nyid kyi drung du phyin nas/ 'di ltar zhus so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba 'phro can mdzad dgos mang du yod cing*/ khyad par/ gser thog dang*/ gser gdugs sogs mdzad pa'i 'phro yang 'di tsam yod/ zhing khams 'di nyid dang*/ rje btsun khyed la blo gtad cing ltos pa bcas pa'i bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas/ ji srid mdzad pa mthar ma phyin bar zhabs pad brtan pa'i thugs mdun bka' drin skyong dgos/ zhus pas/ de'i dngos lan cang ma phebs/ yang zhu lan gzhan ma kha shas kyi mus la/ gser khang nang ma'i thog 'phang stod dgos dang*/ bcos gang dgos grub rjes/ gzims chung gi thang ka rten mchod rnams kyang der bsgrigs/ thub pa gnas bcu snga mo nas yod pa de g.yas g.yon gcig tu bsgrigs/ gsar du tsan dan las grub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis gcig na ning nas e grub bsams kyang lus/ da 'phral du tsan dan lag na gang yod dang bstun pa'i mdzad bcu 'di kha lta byed pa dang*/ bya ba 'phro can/ gser thog gser gdugs 'di lus na mi 'ong*/ da lta phan khyed tshos gang lab thams cad 'grub pa yin pas/ nga'i khams kyis kha lta ma pher yang*/ khyod kyis khur che ba gyis shig ces pa la sogs gsungs pa dang*/ sde pa mgon rgyal ba/ dus der thugs thom me ba'i ngang la lus kyang*/ rjes su dgongs pa sngon btang can gyi bka' lung rang du mngon par byung gsungs so// de nas nyer dgur sleb pa dang*/

dgu gtor rgyas par gnang ba sogs kyang mdzad/ de nas tshes gcig nas/ tshes drug bar du/ sku khams yang khad kyi sku shed chung du song na'ang*/ thugs dam kyi sgrigs phyag mchod sogs kyang ma chag pa rang du mdzad nas/ cung zad nyog pa'i tshul gyis thugs dam spros med 'od gsal rang gi ngang du nyi ma snga phyed yan chad ting nge 'dzin rang la bzhugs par mdzad do// slar yang nyi ma gung la khel ba'i thun mtshams la nye ba/ dus rgyun chags kyi thugs dam grol mtshams kyi tshod de tsam na/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du/ bla gos snam sbyar sogs kyis klubs shing*/ bka' rtags sgom zhwa yang dbu la bzhes/ dbon rin po che dang sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa/ sku mdun du bos nas/ bstan pa'i khur bskur ba'i bka' legs par bstsal nas/ thugs dam gtor bsngo mdzad nas chos skyong la gtad pa mdzad/ yang sde pa mgon rgyal ba la/ thugs brtse ba chen pos yang yang du spyan gyis gzigs nas/ phyag thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsungs so// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam sogs kyi mtshan nas brjod nas 'di skad du/ khyed rnams byin gyis rlobs la mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa rnams dag par gyur cig shin tu dag par gyur cig gsung ba'i ngang nas/ spyan bar snang la lta stangs hrig hrig mdzad cing*/ slar yang phyag nas 'thor ba gnang nas/ mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur cing*/ dag pa'i zhing mchog rnams su 'phrad par shog cig ces gsungs nas/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung dang*/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas/ sku drang por bsrang ste/ spyan ting nge 'dzin shin tu zhi ba'i gzigs stangs su mdzad de/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum pa/ me mo phag gi lo'i hor zla dgu pa'i tshes drug la/

gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim ste mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa yin no// dus der zhabs drung na 'khod pa ni/ sde pa mgon po rgyal mtshan pa/ nang pa mgon po bkra shis pa/ gzims dpon sangs bkris dang gsum/ sgo phyin gsol dpon bsam pa don grub rnams yod pa las/ khong dpon g.yog rnams ni/ dus der rnam rtog gi 'dzin pa rang sar zhi nas/ 'di byed kyi snang ba gang yang ma skyes par yun ring du lus/ cung zad nas sngar ma tshor ba'i rol mo'i sgra dang*/ glu dbyangs kyi rnam pa 'dra ba dang*/ dri bzang gi ngad pa chil chil ba mngon sum gyi grub pa yin no// 'di'i skabs su rang sems skyo ba'i rang mdangs 'di smras so// thub pa'i bstan pa snyigs ma rtsod dus 'dir// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen de// dus 'dir dag pa'i zhing du gshegs tshul bstan// gangs can ljongs 'di mun pa'i gling du gyur// zab don gnas lugs sgrub brgyud bstan pa dang*// yul gyi dbus su blo bur nyid du nub// gdul byar gyur ba'i bu slob thams cad kun// long ba lam mkhan dang ni bral ba 'am// bu gcig shi ba'i ma ltar mya ngan gdungs// lus kyi zungs mi thub par sa la 'gyel// sems yid rab tu skyo ba'i smre sngags 'bod// ci bya gtol med dran pa nyams par gyur// 'di 'dra'i snang tshul bsams na snying rlung ldang*// mya ngan sdug bsngal sol zhig skyob pa rje// skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i// sprul sku dag pa'i zhing du bsdud tshul des// bdag sogs las ngan bskyed pa'i lus ngan 'di// mi rtag 'chi bar ston pa'i brda ston yin// don med tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng kun spangs nas// bslu med yongs 'dzin kun dga'i mtshan can la// gdung shugs drag po'i gsol ba 'debs bzhin du// gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi nyams len la// snying nas sgom sgrub mdzad na mi legs sam// thugs bsam yang yang thong la lha chos mdzod// ces smras so// de lta me phag ston zla 'bring po tha skar can gyi dkar phyogs kyi tshes drug gi snga dro'i thun gsum pa'i mtshams der dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus nas bzung ste/

tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma snga dro'i cha'i bar la thugs dam zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chen po gnas lugs don gyi rtogs pa mthar thug pa dbyings dang*/ ye shes dbyer med pa/ chos sku bde ba chen po'i ngang la bzhugs pa yin no// de'i bar la sku mdangs sngar las lhag pa lta bu snum zhing 'od 'tsher ba/ nam mkha' ni bai ḍūrya'i rgya mtsho bzhin du sngo la dwangs shing g.ya' dag pa dang*/ sprin dang bser bu cung zad kyang med pa'i ngang nas/ me tog gi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa bab pa dang*/ khyad par tshes bcu nas/ rgya spos kyi dri ngad zil gyis gnon pa'i dri bzang gi ngad pa sngar tshor ma myong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bar snang rol mo sgra snyan pa yid 'phrog pas gang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can rnams ni/ gdung mchod 'bul mkhan gyi rtogs ldan gyi rnal 'byor pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dan ma rtogs ldan pa/ kong po rtogs ldan gsum bzhugs pa rnams la sogs pa'i der bzhugs pa thams cad kyi mngon sum du mthong zhing grub pa yin no// gdung gi drung na bzhugs pa'i rdor 'dzin grogs mched gsum po la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rang shugs kyi 'khrungs shing*/ gzigs snang ngo mtshar ba byung tshul ni/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub mo/ rdor 'dzin chen po'i thugs dam gyi gzigs snang la/ seng ge'i gzugs 'gros shin tu che ba/ mdog sngo skya ba la/ rje nyid rigs lnga'i cod pan bzhes te bcibs nas/ chibs kha dang*/ sku la dge 'dun mang pos bskor nas shar phyogs su byon par gzigs so// kong po rtogs ldan la/ nam mkha' sngo dwangs sprin gzhan med pa'i dbus na/ sprin dkar la 'tsher ba'i steng du/ rje nyid dge 'dun shin du mang bas bskor ba rol mo'i sgra snyan dang bcas te bzhugs pa la/ dbu'i steng du rma bya'i sgro'i gdugs yid 'ong dar gyi sham bu sum rtsegs yod pa 'phru dang tog gser las byas pa phub par gzigs so// bla ma 'dan ma la ni/

mdun ri chu 'phan dang*/ gzims chung mchod rtse'i bar 'ja' sna lnga zhing che bas 'brel ba la/ mtshams mtshams su 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang che ba bcu gsum bsgrigs nas 'dug pa'i gong ma'i nang du ston pa sangs rgyas gser mdog nyan thos gnyis dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gsum bzhugs pa/ de 'og gi 'od skor la 'phags pa klu sgrub bar skabs med par/ nyan thos dang*/ khye'u bu mo sogs rgyan bzang zhing mdzes pas gang ba/ tshes bcu gsum man nas/ tshes bco lnga'i bar de ka'i ngang du gnas so// tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma rtse shar la/ gzims chung gi nang gzhan las yangs pa'i nang du/ dge slong gi cha lugs ngur smrig can dbu reg zhabs rjen grangs med byon pa phal cher spos phor thogs/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan sogs shin tu mang ba'i dbus su/ rje nyid nam bza' chos gos bklubs pa la/ dbu rgyan rigs lngas spras pa/ gzims chung gi bar snang la yun ring tsam bzhugs rjes/ bla ma 'dan ma rang la gsung gleng mang po phebs/ de mus 'ja' gur rim pa brgyud de/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bar du rim par brgyud pa yin no// de nub srod kyi cha la'ang 'ja' gur sogs ma yal bar gzigs 'dug go// de tshun tshes bco lnga byung ngo cog la gzims chung gi rab gsal nas rtogs ldan kong po'i gzigs lam du/ ri bong zhig phyag grangs med 'tshal ba gzigs pa yin 'dug go// khong gsum dam tshig gtsang bas gzigs snang khyad par can byung ba de yis mtshon te skal ldan gzhan la byung ba ni brjod kyis mi lang ba yin no// bla ma 'dan ma la rje mya ngan las 'das rjes ti ser mtsho mchod 'bul ba la 'byon dgos par lung bstan pa ni/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du/ sgam po dang*/ tsā ri sogs la sgrub pa la 'byon par zhus pas/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyod dam tshig gtsang ba'i slob ma yin pas/ re zhig thag nye 'khor du sdod/ dus bab la/ gnas dang ri khrod la song chog pa yong ba yin/

yang nged kyi don phran tshegs shig sgrub dgos byung ba srid/ ces gsungs pa la brten nas 'di phyogs la bzhugs rjes su/ rje mya ngan las 'das rjes/ ti ser mtsho mchod dang gser 'bum bzhengs par 'byon rogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ rje nyid bka' lung dran te/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas thugs kyi blangs nas/ ti ser byon pa yin no// rje btsun dam pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag kun dga'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyi snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab pa la brten pa'i sku gdung rin po che mjal mkhan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ dam tshig gtsang mi gtsang gi dbye ba shes par dka' bas re zhig rin po che'i sgrom bur bzhugs su gsol nas/ dar gos kyi na bza' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bklubs pa dang*/ mdun du mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa bkod pa mchog tu gyur pa phun sum tshogs pa dang dam tshig gtsang ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba dang bcas te gzims khang rang du/ dngul gdung ma grub bar du tshogs gsog pa'i yul du bzhugs pa yin no// sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ rang gzhan gyi skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa ni/ dgung zhag nam rdzogs kyi bar la/ gdung gi drung du mar me re res kyang nyin zhag dpag tu med pa rang 'bar la thub pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad du sa chu shin tu dros nas/ dbyar dus lta bur gyur te/ ting phor nang gi nas la/ chu 'thor ba rnams la/ nas kyi ljang pa sor drug lhag pa skyes pa kun gyi mig lam du mthong ba dang*/ lung pa phu mda' dag gi ba lu'i me tog dang*/ dgon pa so so'i ldum ra'i me tog la sogs te/ me tog mtha' dag rang shar du byung ste shin tu bkra bar gyur pa skye bo kun gyi mngon sum du mthong ba kun gyi mig lam du mthong zhing*/ 'bri gung chos rje'i grong rtags yin par kun gyi mthun grub du gyur te/ sngon shin tu mi dad pa'i skye bo rnams kyang*/

mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can de rnams la yid lhag par dad pa'i mos gus skyes te/ sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod de bshags pa byed cing*/ phyis gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson pa sogs ma dad pa'i snang ba sgyur zhing*/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa yin no// de lta bu'i dpe gcig tsam brjod na/ 'phan yul mda'i dgon pa/ gsal khang dang nye ba na/ lcang sgang dbon po bya ba/ 'bri gung pa la/ dga' ldan pa'i ser dmag byas dus kyi dmag phyogs gcig gis mgo dpon byed myong ba zhig dus der rang gi bla g.yel du me tog rgya men mang po shar byung ba la/ lag pas g.yabs te/ 'bri gung chos rje/ 'bri gung chos rje/ dgun grang sgang gi me tog rang shar 'di/ khyed kyi grongs rtags rang du 'dug pas/ nged mang po gcig gis sdig pa chen po bsags pa 'dra zer nas/ 'chi ma 'don zhing 'dug pa/ de'i nye skor kun gyi mthun grub la snyon med pa yin zhing*/ de 'dra'i lo rgyus mang yang 'bri yis mi lang bas/ dpe tsam zhig bkod pa'o// rje btsun gyi dgongs rdzogs ji ltar byas pa'i tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ dus yun mi ring bar/ jo gdan mkhan po/ dgra bcom pa grags rgyal ba dpon slob bcu phrag du mas gtso mdzad pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs lnga stong tsam dang*/ skye bo 'jig rten pa'i tshogs khri phrag bco brgyad las mi nyung ba dang bcas pa rnams la/ bza' ba dang btung ba'i bye brag phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang*/ gser dngul dang*/ gos dar dang*/ ja sig dang snam phrug dang*/ nas sran dang*/ rkang bzhi la sogs te/ rang gzhan kun gyi blor mi shong ba'i rgyu dngos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'bul ba dang*/ sbyin pa sngar gyi srol bzang po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi skye bo thams cad kyi re ba 'dod dgus bskang bar mdzad pa yin no// de nas dge 'dun stong phrag phyed gsum tsam gyi mchod pa re zhig gi bar la rgyun ma chad par phul zhing*/

de rnams la yang zhabs tog dang 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub par mdzad do// gzhan yang*/ ti se la gser 'bum bzhengs pa/ ma pham la gdung mchod/ bal po shing kun la gser gdugs 'gel ba/ gnas gsum la tshogs 'khor 'gyed dang bcas pa/ gzhan 'di phyogs kyi dgon so so la mang ja skol ba 'gyed kyi bye brag la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa myur bar bsgrubs pa sogs brjod kyis mi lang ba yod kyang 'dir ma bris so// rje 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel ngo mtshar can byon tshul ni/ sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu nang ring bsrel dang*/ rten gyi phung por gyur kyang*/ rnam pa sku'i dbyibs ma zhig par/ dngul gdung bkra shis 'od 'bar rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ bzo dang bkod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pa blta bas chog mi shes pa'i nang du/ bdag sogs 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du bzhugs su gsol ba yin no// thugs dam 'od gsal las grol dus kyi/ byang sems dkar dmar dang*/ chab ser gyi rnam pa cung zad byung ba la/ kong po rtogs ldan gyis rtsam pa dang*/ sman sna dang*/ spos sna gang 'dzom rnams/ byang sems dkar dmar dang*/ chab ser rnams dang*/ bsres nas/ 'dam btugs byas te/ g.yang ru zer ba'i phyag g.yog pa zhig yod pa la'ang*/ byin rlabs de nas tshon pa gcig byin nas/ de'i lhag ma khong rang gi byin rlabs ril bu bcos pa'i nang du/ dung g.yas 'khyil/ kha dog shel gyi mdog lta bu/ dod la mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa gsum byon pa yin no// g.yang ru'i byin rlabs kyi rten phyed bshags la btang ba la yang*/ g.yas g.yon phyed bshags nang du/ dung g.yas 'khyil ya mtshan pa/ re re ste gnyis byon zhing*/ de lta bu'i dung g.yas 'khyil lnga byon pa ni/ mngon sum du gyur pa da lta mig lam du mjal rgyu yod pa mthun grub du gyur pa yin no// gzhan yang kong po rtogs ldan gyi phyag gi byin rlabs de las/

cung zad re mched pa rnams la yang*/ ring bsrel byed pa dang*/ byin rlabs de'i mu la gdung tsha btab pa la'ang ring bsrel 'khrungs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de ltar rje btsun dam pa de nyid zhal bzhugs dus/ sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las bstan pa'i bya ba/ rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che sgrub pa'i blo stobs dang ldan pa/ ci mdzad yon tan du mthong ba'i mos gus dang ldan pa/ sku mya ngan las 'das rjes/ dgongs rdzogs mthar phyin du sgrub pa'i dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skyes mchog rje nyid kyi ye shes mgon pos byin gyis brlabs par lung bstan pa'i rje blon du gyur pa dpal mi'i dbang po sde bdag mgon po rgyal mtshan pas khur shin tu che bar bzhes pa'i sgo nas dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub pa'o// de ltar ngo mtshar ba'i rjes kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su thim nas mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan pa'i le'u yin no//

de ltar bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba snyan ngag tshig gi sdeb sbyor dam pos ma bcings par/ bla ma dam pa'i yon tan rang lugs su gsal bar ston pa'i me long*/ gang gi mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyi rje btsun nyid la dad pa'i spu long g.yos te dkar po'i sa bon skrun pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi zhing sar gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba 'di nyid rang gi dngos su mthong ba dang thos pa'i steng du mkhyen brtse'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i dbon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rnam thar tshig bcad du mdzad pa dang*/ bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar kha skongs dang*/ dpal mi'i dbang po mgon po rgyal mtshan pas zin bris su mdzad pa sogs la dpyad de rang bzo dang*/ gong 'og ma log par rje nyid kyi zhabs pad spyi bos len pa'i ri khrod pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'byams pa'i ming blo gros rgya mtshos phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa yin no// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
